method: AI-selected ice-plane landmarks on clear reference frames; four outer-circle/line intersections fit each homography, inner-circle points withheld for a same-image geometry check.
coordinate_convention: View-local metres: origin tee; +x toward image right along tee line; +y toward image foreground along centre line. Not canonical throwing orientation; cameras must not be fused using these coordinates.
limitations: Nominal ring radii, not surveyed dimensions.
Annotations are from the same AI conducting implementation; not independent ground truth.
Ice-plane homography does not correct above-ice handle parallax.
Per-image feature registration must succeed before reference calibration is propagated.
